statements.t: “As a result of our significant third quarter and October outperformance compared to our prior expectations, as well as continued confidence in the strength of demand for the remainder of the year, we have raised our outlook for full year 2026 meaningfully.
We have increased the midpoint of our full year 2026 guidance for Adjusted EBITDAre by $8 million and Adjusted FFO per share by $0.09 compared to prior guidance.

We continue to believe our high-quality and well-located portfolio is well-positioned for future growth as we expect lodging demand for higher-end hotels and resorts to continue to be strong while supply growth remains limited for the foreseeable future.”

Net proceeds from the sale will be utilized for general corporate purposes, which may include debt repayments, potential acquisitions consistent with the Company’s strategy, and/or share repurchases under the Company’s existing authorization.
The Company has updated its full year 2026 outlook.
Additionally, a live webcast of the conference call will be available through the Company’s website, www.xeniareit.com.
A replay of the conference call will be archived and available online through the Investor Relations section of the Company’s website for 90 days.
Accordingly, there is no assurance that the Company's expectations will be realized.

statements.t: We expect to meet our short-term liquidity requirements from cash on hand, cash flow from hotel operations, use of our unencumbered asset base, asset dispositions, borrowings under our Revolving Credit Facility, and proceeds from various capital market transactions, including issuances of debt and equity securities.
To the extent we are able to successfully improve the performance of our portfolio, we believe this will result in increased operating cash flows.

The restricted cash as of September 30, 2026 primarily consisted of $78.1 million related to FF&E reserves as required per the terms of our management and franchise agreements, $5.7 million in deposits made for capital projects, cash held in restricted escrows of $0.7 million primarily for real estate taxes and mortgage escrows and $0.4 million for escrow holdbacks.

Future determinations regarding the declaration and payment of dividends will be at the discretion of our Board of Directors and will depend on then-existing conditions, including our results of operations, payout ratio, capital requirements, financial condition, prospects, contractual arrangements, any limitations on payment of dividends present in our current and future debt agreements, maintaining our REIT…

We believe that our cash position, short-term investments, cash from operations, borrowing capacity under our Revolving Credit Facility, and access to the capital markets, including pursuant to our ATM program, will be adequate to meet all of our funding requirements and capital deployment objectives both in the short-term and long-term.
From time to time, we will consider open market purchases or tenders of our Senior Notes or other public indebtedness when considered advantageous relative to other uses of capital.
We have been and will continue to be prudent with respect to our capital spending, taking into account our cash flows from operations.

Our calculation of FFO may not be comparable to measures calculated by other companies who do not use the Nareit definition of FFO or do not calculate FFO per diluted share in accordance with Nareit guidance.
